spec.name: Helix Glowfrond
spec.description: A tall bioluminescent alien plant in the Avatar style: a dark curling stalk rising from a mound of glowing roots and bulbs, crowned with a spiral of magenta fronds whose tips, vein-lines and undersides shine cyan and violet.
spec.layout: Model space: +Y up, front faces +Z, centred on x = 0, standing on y = 0. The silhouette is a dark twisting stalk (about 3.2 m tall, leaning slightly forward, centreline drifting from [0, 0, 0.1] at the ground up to [0, 2.75, 0.75]) rising out of a low gnarled root mound that flares to a radius of about 1.4 m at the floor. Around the lower stalk, a cluster of translucent glowing sacs and pods hangs and bulges on short stems. At the crown hub the stalk splits into 5 to 7 long tapering fronds that spiral outward and curl under at the tips, the longest reaching about 1.5 m out and down to y ≈ 2.4, each frond striped with glowing vein ribs and capped with a bright luminous tip. The floor around the roots is dotted with small glowing undergrowth: a few stalk mushrooms, sprouts and spore motes, kept small and subordinate to the hero plant. Style on every part: near-black blue-teal bark and ground lit from within; every luminous element (sacs, veins, tips, spores, mushrooms) is its own bright flat colour and built as a separate small part seated on the darker surface, so the glow reads as geometry, not shading. Faceted low-poly surfaces throughout.

parts.builds: The floor-level foundation. A low dome mound of dark mossy ground (a squashed lathe or swept ring, rootMoss, about 0.35 m tall) from which 6 to 8 thick gnarled roots radiate outward and dive into the ground, each root a tapering swept tube in barkDark with barkMid ridge stripes seated on top as thin curved rods. Between the roots, small glowing root-vein filaments (thin rods, glowCyan) trace from the stalk base outward, fading to glowTeal at their ends. Where the roots meet the stalk, a ring of 5 to 7 swollen bulbous root-knots (small spheres, barkMid) each capped by a tiny glowing pore (glowCyan disc, seated on the knot facing up). The mound's top face carries a few moss tufts (small spikes, rootMoss darker) and 2 or 3 pale spore motes floating just above it (tiny spheres, sporeGold). Everything shares the groundRing mount at the centre and meets the stalk exactly at stalkBase.
parts.attaches: Centre on groundRing; the stalk of the stalk part rises from stalkBase at its centre; the undergrowth part surrounds it, sharing the floor ring.

parts.builds: The hero trunk. One smooth catmull chain (stem to stalkMid to crown) swept with a tapering radius from about 0.42 m at the base to 0.2 m at the crown hub, in barkDark with a countershading drift toward barkMid on the lit side; give it a gentle S-curve leaning forward as laid out. Vertical ridge fins: 4 to 6 narrow extruded blades running up the stalk at different heights, barkRidge, seated on the surface with b.surface and ending in a small glowing vein tip (glowCyan) at each blade's top. Horizontal glowing rings: 3 bands of small studs or thin swept loops round the trunk at about y = 0.8, 1.5 and 2.2, glowTeal, spaced like growth-node scars. A short branch stub halfway up carries a single small side frond (one curling swept tube, frondMagenta, with a glowCyan tip). The stalk's base is buried into the root mound at stalkBase; its top terminates exactly at crownHub where the fronds attach.
parts.attaches: Roots into stalkBase over the rootMound part; carries sacCluster's sacs on its flank at sacAnchor; ends at crownHub under the frondCrown part.

parts.builds: The signature feature: 5 to 7 long curling fronds sprouting from crownHub, each one its own swept chain riding a frond joint. Each frond is a tapering spiral path (radius from about 0.09 m at the base to a thin 0.015 m tip) that rises, arcs outward and curls under, the longest reaching about 1.5 m; different fronds spiral at different azimuths so the crown reads as a helix from every side. Frond body in frondMagenta shaded to frondDeep on the underside, every frond edged with a thin swept rim line in frondEdge. Along each frond's upper side, a row of glowing vein studs or small leaf blades (frondEdge and glowViolet, alternating) placed with b.along, and at each frond's tip a bright luminous bud: a small sphere of glowCyan inside a tiny collar of frondDeep, with 3 or 4 short glow filaments (thin rods, glowCyan) splaying from it. Where each frond leaves the hub, a sheathing bract (a small extruded leaf, frondDeep with frondEdge margin) covers the junction, and the hub itself is a swollen cone of barkMid with a glowing crown-eye disc (glowCyan) facing forward.
parts.attaches: Sprouts exactly at crownHub on top of the stalk part; nothing hangs below y = 2.35 except the tips, which stay clear of the sacs and undergrowth.

parts.builds: The bioluminescent bulb cluster. 6 to 9 translucent teardrop sacs of graded sizes (largest about 0.3 m tall, smallest 0.1 m) hanging and bulging from short stems on the stalk's lower flank around sacAnchor, using the sacCluster hinge joint. Each sac is a lathe or squashed sphere in sacMembrane with a visible inner core sphere of sacCore, seated so the core shows through a small opening; each sac's narrow neck is a short swept tube in barkDark connecting back to the stalk, and its base carries a tiny glowing collar ring (glowTeal). Two or three sacs are cracked open at the top, their rims peeled back in barkMid with a bright spore cluster (3 to 5 tiny spheres, sporeGold and glowCyan) spilling inside. Thin connecting vines (thin rods, glowViolet) link neighbouring sacs so the cluster reads as one organism. The cluster hangs from sacAnchor on the stalk part's surface and must not touch the floor.
parts.attaches: Hangs from sacAnchor on the stalk part's flank; sits above the rootMound and inside the undergrowth part's outer ring.

parts.builds: The modest staging around the hero plant's footprint. A scatter of small glowing flora inside the root ring: 4 or 5 stalk mushrooms (thin swept stems in barkMid, flared caps in mushroomCap with glowing gill discs and rim rings in mushroomGill facing down), 6 or 8 curved sprout blades (extruded leaves in sproutLeaf with a glowTeal midrib, leaning outward), and 5 or 6 tiny glow pustules (small domes, glowCyan and glowViolet) on the ground among them. A few spore motes float between y = 0.4 and 1.0 (tiny spheres, sporeGold and glowCyan), and one fallen frond segment lies across the ground at the front, frondMagenta with a dimmed glowTeal tip, to tie the undergrowth to the crown's palette. Everything is small (under 0.45 m tall), ring-shaped around the centre, and clearly subordinate to the stalk and crown.
parts.attaches: Surrounds the rootMound part on the same groundRing, staying outside the stalk's footprint and below the hanging glowSacs.

calls.reasoning:
I'm writing a spec JSON for a bioluminescent alien plant in Avatar style — glowing bioluminescent flora from Pandora. Need 3-6 parts, mounts, joints, palette ≤24, budgets ≤900 total.

Design: A large glowing "helicoradian"-like / alien tree plant: central stalk, spiraling tentacle fronds, glowing bulb cluster at base, glow spores, ground base with roots. Avatar style: bioluminescent cyan/blue/purple glow on magenta/pink fronds, dark trunk.

Structure:
- part 1: root base — gnarled roots, ground mossy mound, glowing pod cluster (bulbs)
- part 2: central stalk — tall curved trunk with glowing rings/ventral stripes
- part 3: spiral frond crown — curling tentacle-like fronds with glowing tips
- part 4: glowing seed bulbs / spore sacs hanging
- part 5: undergrowth — small glowing mushrooms/fungi around base

Maybe 5 parts. Joints: a static model could have joints: [] but glowy plants might want fronds to sway — include a few joints: stalk spine, frond fans. Keep joints modest: root, stalk spine chain (spine), a few frond bases (tentacle role), maybe bulb hinge.

Let me define coordinate layout. Height ~4.2m tall tree-like helicoradian. Size: width 3.6, height 4.2, depth 3.2.

Actually let's make it a cluster: central stalk at x=0 rising to ~3.8m, crown of curling fronds spiraling, base of glowing bulbs, roots at floor.

Mounts:
- groundRing: [0, 0, 0]
- stalkBase: [0, 0.45, 0.1]
- crownPoint: [0, 2.6, 0.55] where fronds attach
- bulbAnchor: [0.4, 1.4, 0.7] hanging sacs

Joints:
- root "base" at [0,0,0] dir up, role spine
- "stalk1..3" chain along stalk
- "frondBaseL/R" tentacle roles... but fronds built by one part. Keep skeleton: base(root), stalk1, stalk2, crown, plus maybe sway joints for fronds: frondA1 etc. Simpler: root "stem", "stalk", "crown" role spine/neck. Each part lists joints its geometry rides.

Joints list:
{ "name": "stem", "at": [0, 0.05, 0.1], "dir": [0, 1, 0.2], "role": "spine" }
{ "name": "stalkMid", "parent": "stem", "at": [0, 1.5, 0.35], "dir": [0, 1, 0.3], "role": "spine" }

{ "name": "frondBack", ...}
